name: lexicon
title: Lexicon
description: A language-school theme set like a pocket bilingual dictionary: thin cool-white paper, black ink and one dictionary blue, teachers as bold run-in headwords with italic labels in two ruled columns, the week’s classes as senses under each day, and the menu repeated as black thumb-index half-moons down the page edge.

tokens.--font-head: bold grotesque for headwords, headings, the site title, the menu, the running heads and class times
tokens.--font-body: Times-like serif for running text, definitions, class names and labels
tokens.--weight-head: weight of headwords, headings, class times, the site title, the “try a class” link and the thumb letters
tokens.--text-s: small text: menu, guide words, class times, tags, footer and the home page cross-references
tokens.--text-m: base size of body text, entries, day headwords and the “try a class” link
tokens.--text-l: the site title, intro lines, running-head titles, section headings, the home page’s school entry and the thumb letters
tokens.--text-xl: page titles and an instructor's name on their own page
tokens.--leading-body: line height of running text (set tight, like a dictionary)
tokens.--tracking-caps: letter spacing of the smallest capitalised headings in page text
tokens.--color-bg: page background — the thin cool-white dictionary leaf; also the letter on the current thumb tab
tokens.--color-desk: the desk beside the leaf on wide screens, a shade darker than the paper
tokens.--color-text: body text, headings, definitions, labels and class names
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: intro lines, guide words, the teacher after “with”, empty states, the page number and the footer
tokens.--color-accent: dictionary blue: headwords, links, the “try a class” box, the current menu marker and thumb tab, list markers, the first-visit note’s bar and the focus ring
tokens.--color-accent-deep: darker blue for links under the pointer
tokens.--color-rule: black rules: running heads, the centre rule, beside the school entry, table heads, quotes, photo frames and the footer
tokens.--color-hairline: thin grey lines: under the masthead, the leaf’s edges, between table rows and around code blocks
tokens.--color-tab: the thumb-index half-moons, the skip link and the Today flag
tokens.--color-on-tab: the letter on a thumb tab and text on the skip link and the Today flag
tokens.--color-tint: pale blue behind code blocks and selected text
tokens.--column-min: narrowest a dictionary column may get before the two columns become one
tokens.--column-gap: space between the two columns, with the centre rule in the middle
tokens.--gutter: space at the left and right edges of the screen
tokens.--space-s: small gaps: in the masthead, in the page-number row and around the skip link
tokens.--space-l: large gap between sections and above page titles
tokens.--indent: hanging indent of an entry's second and later lines (class lines hang about twice as far)
tokens.--rule-thin: width of thin rules and the centre rule
tokens.--rule-thick: width of the current menu marker, the “try a class” box, the bar beside notes and quotes, and the focus ring
tokens.--tab-depth: how far each thumb tab cuts into the leaf on wide screens (twice as tall; phones get six tenths)
tokens.--photo-small: width of a photo beside an entry in the list
